question: Consider 50 evenly placed points on a circle with centre at the origin and radius \(R\) such that the arc length between any two consecutive points is the same. The complex numbers represented by these points form

options.A: an arithmetic progression with common difference \(\left(\cos\frac{2\pi}{50}+i\sin\frac{2\pi}{50}\right)\)
options.B: an arithmetic progression with common difference \(\left(R\cos\frac{2\pi}{50}+iR\sin\frac{2\pi}{50}\right)\)
options.C: a geometric progression with common ratio \(\left(\cos\frac{2\pi}{50}+i\sin\frac{2\pi}{50}\right)\)
options.D: a geometric progression with common ratio \(\left(R\cos\frac{2\pi}{50}+iR\sin\frac{2\pi}{50}\right)

source.title: Test of Mathematics at the 10 + 2 Level
